description: This is a Kotlin source file defining a class named CameraHandler responsible for managing camera operations such as listing devices, capturing photos, and recording video clips within an Android application. The class includes methods for handling camera interactions, logging, error handling, and payload size validation.

classes.name: CameraHandler
classes.description: A class managing camera operations such as listing devices, capturing photos, and recording video clips. It handles logging, error management, payload size checks, and interactions with camera hardware and UI feedback.

methods.name: handleList
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the list of available camera devices and returns a JSON payload with device details, or an error result if an exception occurs.

methods.name: handleSnap
methods.description: Handles the process of capturing a photo, including UI feedback, camera trigger, error handling, and returning the photo payload encoded in JSON.

methods.name: handleClip
methods.description: Records a video clip from the camera, checks payload size constraints, encodes the video in Base64, and provides UI feedback and error handling.
